headline: Approved two Teamsters Local Union #42 contracts covering food service and transportation workers, July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2029.
summary: Members discussed two memorandums of agreement with Gloucester Teamsters Local Union #42, one for food service workers and one for transportation workers. Vice Chairperson Melvin gave an overview of the contract language changes. Both agreements were approved by a 5-0 roll call vote.
decisions: Approved the Memorandum of Agreement with the Gloucester Teamsters Local Union #42 Food Service Workers, effective July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2029, by a 5-0 roll call vote.
Approved the Memorandum of Agreement with the Gloucester Teamsters Local Union #42 Transportation Workers, effective July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2029, by a 5-0 roll call vote.
